article_title: What food items should you stock up on in case of an emergency?

tasks.prompt: Why does the article suggest keeping a small supply of long-life food?
options: To prepare for possible interruptions to food supplies while choosing nutritious items
To replace all fresh food permanently
Because supermarkets have stopped selling fresh products
To avoid drinking water during storms
tasks.correct_answer: To prepare for possible interruptions to food supplies while choosing nutritious items
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה ממליצה להיערך לשיבושים אפשריים באספקה באמצעות מזון עמיד ולבחור אותו בתשומת לב תזונתית.

tasks.prompt: Which group does Dr Sammie Gill include as a source of protein for an emergency cupboard?
options: Sweetened breakfast bars and chocolate
Canned chickpeas, lentils and kidney beans
Instant noodles and tinned soup
Fruit tinned in syrup
tasks.correct_answer: Canned chickpeas, lentils and kidney beans
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גיל מונה קטניות משומרות בין מקורות החלבון המומלצים.

tasks.prompt: What does “put a strain on” mean when the article discusses the food supply chain?
options: Guarantee a larger harvest
Make food taste less appealing
Place pressure on the system that brings food to shops
Turn long-life food into fresh food
tasks.correct_answer: Place pressure on the system that brings food to shops
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר לחץ או קושי שמכבידים על שרשרת האספקה.

tasks.prompt: What does “abundant” mean in Prof Richard Wilding's warning about supermarket products?
options: Too expensive to buy
Available only online
Unhealthy when eaten often
Plentiful or easy to find
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה למוצרים שבדרך כלל מצויים בשפע, אך עלולים לפתע להיות חסרים.

tasks.prompt: What does Gill recommend checking when buying tinned food?
options: The amounts of salt and sugar, including whether food is packed in brine or syrup
Whether the label shows the name of a storm
Whether all tins contain fresh vitamin C
The colour of the supermarket shelf
tasks.correct_answer: The amounts of salt and sugar, including whether food is packed in brine or syrup
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גיל מזהירה מתכולת מלח וסוכר ומעדיפה שימורים במים על פני תמלחת או סירופ.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “shelf life” refer to when McManamon discusses nuts?
options: The size of the shelf where the nuts are sold
How long the nuts remain suitable to keep before they spoil
The amount of protein in each nut
The time needed to cook nuts in a tin
tasks.correct_answer: How long the nuts remain suitable to keep before they spoil
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חיי מדף הם משך הזמן שבו המוצר נשמר ראוי לשימוש; אגוזים עשויים להחזיק פחות זמן.

tasks.prompt: Name two kinds of disruptions mentioned that could affect the process of getting food into shops and homes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני גורמים מתוך אלה שהכתבה מונה; אין להציג שיבוש עתידי כעובדה שכבר אירעה.

tasks.prompt: Why can tinned fruit and long-life milk help beyond simply supplying calories?
expected_points: Tinned fruit can add fluid, vitamins and fibre, and its juice can be drunk
Long-life milk supplies protein and calcium as well as fluid
Both help diversify nutrition when supplies are disrupted
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות תועלת נוספת של כל אחד משני המוצרים, ולא לטעון שהם תחליף בלעדי למים.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's practical advice for preparing an emergency food cupboard in four or five sentences.
expected_points: Keep a modest supply of long-life products for potential disruption
Include complex carbohydrates and protein sources such as grains, pulses or canned fish
Include tinned fruit and long-life milk for nutrients and fluid
Check salt and sugar, favouring water-packed food over brine or syrup
Remember fluids and that canning can reduce some vitamins without making canned food useless
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית עצות מזון, תזונה ונוזלים, מבלי לטעון שיש מחסור נוכחי או ששימורים זהים תמיד למזון טרי.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the article balances preparation for supply disruption with avoiding unnecessary alarm.
expected_points: The government urged people to add a few long-life items
Wilding advises against being overly worried and notes shipping professionals adapt
He suggests flexibility if familiar products become scarce
Nutrition experts recommend varied healthy shelf-stable foods and caution about salt and sugar
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה באנגלית המבחינה בין היערכות שקולה לבין תחזית ודאית למחסור, ולהביא לפחות שתי ראיות מהכתבה.
